description: Use this when you are about to fix a made clip, first: returns every word with its index, text and times on the clip (seconds), whether it is a filler ("um"), whether a long pause follows it, and whether it is already cut; plus the hook title, the caption look, the trim, the frame (shape, layout, crop, moves, split, speaker follow, logo, end frame), a one-line summary ("14 ums, 3 pauses over 0.6 s") and any notes the person sent you from Slice. Changes nothing.

clip_id.description: The clip's id (from get_episode, get_job or the Slice link).

open_in_slice.description: The clip in the Slice editor, where the person sees the change.
